Text.name: reference_rules
Text.value: Granola lists acceptable finer/coarser answers. A source link alone is not evidence until read.

Text.name: rules
Text.value: Judge exactly the displayed answer, not an imagined continuation. Supported paraphrases and meaningful coarser answers can be Correct. A material contradicted claim makes the answer Incorrect. Missing support is not proof of falsity: select Cannot determine for an unsupported attribute, extra claim or conflicting references. A concrete candidate with hedging is not an abstention. Record this decision BEFORE looking anything up.

Text.name: verification_rules
Text.value: Use targeted web lookup for reference gaps, suspicious/conflicting references or time-sensitive facts. Prefer original/official sources, then reliable reference works. Search snippets and AI-generated answers alone are insufficient. Record what the source establishes; a coarser answer must still answer the question meaningfully. Use the question's stated time, or the dataset reference period where known; do not silently replace historical gold with today's facts. If unresolved, keep Cannot determine. Do not change the reference-only judgment after searching.

TextArea.name: evidence_urls
TextArea.placeholder: One http(s) source URL per line

TextArea.name: evidence_note
TextArea.placeholder: Short supporting fact or quotation; mention the relevant date for changing facts

TextArea.name: review_note
TextArea.placeholder: Optional: ambiguity, reference issue, or a case needing a second reviewer
